recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. FHIR-50383's implementer-facing ALS wording is now aligned with the applied resolution; any independent audit of the removed nutrition diagram should be handled under FHIR-52961.
issue_request: FHIR-50383 was an Applied, Persuasive R6 OO change request for Nutrition module suggested changes. It asked to include diet/nutrition education information in the ALS outpatient use case and to include related resources in the workflow diagram; the Jira resolution supplied specific Outpatient/Ambulatory Use Case bullet updates, and a Jira comment split the diagram portion to FHIR-52961.
initial_application: Upstream commit f08af008345a71485a7eee5f3ce559a3c12559dd explicitly applied FHIR-50383 by adding the pre-op nutrition education bullet and replacing the Food & Nutrition Services transmission sentence with DME/home-care wording in source/nutrition-module.html. That application left transcription mismatches in the approved text, including the misspelled phrase "tube feedinb supplies".
additional_context: source/nutrition-module.html is included in current build navigation by source/hierarchy.xml, and the Nutrition resources are active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-52961 is the linked Applied follow-up for the diagram portion and the current module source no longer references the nutrition relationship diagram. Targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision for the ALS/DME wording.
reconciliation: The published commit updates only source/nutrition-module.html: it restores "their" and the comma in the respiratory-status sentence, adds the missing comma after "office visit", pluralizes the G-tube indications sentence, and corrects "tube feedinb supplies" to "tube feeding supplies".
source_changes: source/nutrition-module.html: corrected the ALS outpatient use-case wording and DME supplies typo to match the approved FHIR-50383 resolution.
